tasks.title: Verify the agent-ready kit
tasks.objective: Prove a fresh checkout is complete, local-only, and reproducible before product work begins.
deliverables: Run bootstrap, doctor, CI, demo, UI, and health checks from a clean tree.
Record exact runtime and operating-system information.
Fix packaging defects only.
tasks.stopCondition: Stop when a clean checkout passes every command and BOOTSTRAP_REPORT.md matches the evidence.

tasks.title: Ratify protocol RFC and compatibility fixtures
tasks.objective: Freeze provider-neutral v1 contracts before persistent implementations depend on them.
deliverables: Review RFC 0001 and all schemas.
Add correlation, causation, workspace, classification, and stable errors additively.
Add valid, invalid, and backward-compatibility fixtures.
tasks.stopCondition: Stop when ratify protocol rfc and compatibility fixtures meets the acceptance gate without expanding adjacent scope.

tasks.title: Define application ports and conformance tests
tasks.objective: Create replaceable application interfaces for every provider boundary.
deliverables: Define state, events, artifacts, models, workflows, policy, candidates, memory, and health ports.
Add bootstrap conformance tests.
Prohibit provider payloads in domain types.
tasks.stopCondition: Stop when define application ports and conformance tests meets the acceptance gate without expanding adjacent scope.

tasks.title: Implement PostgreSQL repositories

tasks.stopCondition: Stop when implement postgresql repositories meets the acceptance gate without expanding adjacent scope.

tasks.title: Implement migration runner and recovery tests

tasks.stopCondition: Stop when implement migration runner and recovery tests meets the acceptance gate without expanding adjacent scope.
